name: Mouhamed Gueye
comment: Gueye underwent surgery Tuesday to repair a fractured left foot that he suffered during a workout last week, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

name: Henri Veesaar
comment: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.

name: Devin Carter
comment: Carter has been diagnosed with mononucleosis and is without a timetable for a return, Gary Washburn of The Boston Globe reports.

name: Egor Demin
comment: The Nets exercised Demin's third-year team option for the 2027-28 season, Sharif Phillips-Keaton of USA Today reports Thursday.

name: Tyler Bilodeau
comment: Bilodeau (shoulder) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against Indiana.

name: Kon Knueppel
comment: Knueppel (hamstring) was recalled from the G League's Greensboro Swarm on Friday. He remains out for Friday's contest against the Wizards.

name: Coby White
comment: Head coach Charles Lee said Monday that White (calf) remains without a timeline for a return, though Lee added that he'll have a better idea of where things stand following the Hornets' two-game road trip, Rod Boone of The Charlotte Observer reports.

name: Grant Williams
comment: Williams (hamstring) will be re-evaluated following Charlotte's upcoming two-game road trip, Rod Boone reports.

name: Kylan Boswell
comment: Boswell (knee) is out for Wednesday's season opener against the Nets.

name: Dailyn Swain
comment: Swain (back) has been ruled out for Friday's game against Boston.

name: Nic Claxton
comment: Claxton (hamstring) participated in individual drills Monday morning and hopes to join the team for practice next week, Joe Cowley of the Chicago Sun-Times reports.

name: Jaylon Tyson
comment: Tyson (ankle) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Bucks.

name: Meleek Thomas
comment: Thomas (foot) is questionable for Saturday's game against the Bucks.

name: Sergio de Larrea
comment: Head coach Dusty May said Friday that de Larrea (knee) will be re-evaluated next week, Noah Weber of TheSmokingCuban.com reports.

name: Santi Aldama
comment: Aldama (knee) is listed as out for Friday's game against the Rockets.

name: Tarik Biberovic
comment: Biberovic (heel) is out for Friday's game against the Rockets.

name: Dereck Lively II
comment: Lively (foot) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Pacers.

name: Alpha Diallo
comment: Diallo (personal/wrist) has been ruled out for Friday's game against Phoenix, Vic Lombardi of Altitude Sports reports.

name: Spencer Jones
comment: Jones (hamstring) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against New Orleans.

name: Julian Strawther
comment: Strawther (knee) was diagnosed with a left knee sprain Friday and will be re-evaluated in six weeks, Vinny Benedetto of The Denver Gazette reports.

name: Isaiah Joe
comment: Joe (hip) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Nets.

name: Jalen Duren
comment: Duren will be re-evaluated in two weeks due to a right hamstring strain, Eric Vincent of ClutchPoints.com reports.

name: Kristaps Porzingis
comment: The Warriors are exploring potential trades involving Porzingis (personal), who remains away from the team indefinitely while dealing with ongoing health concerns, Anthony Slater of ESPN.com reports.

name: Moses Moody
comment: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

name: Jimmy Butler III
comment: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

name: Reed Sheppard
comment: Houston picked up Sheppard's (back) fourth-year team option Friday, per Lachard Binkley of SI.com.

name: Alperen Sengun
comment: Sengun (back) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Mavericks, Mike Curtis of The Dallas Morning News reports.

name: Steven Adams
comment: Head coach Ime Udoka said Monday that Adams could be out "a week or two" due to his right soleus strain, Lachard Binkley of SI.com reports.

name: Obi Toppin
comment: Toppin (back) has been ruled out for Friday's game against Miami.

name: T.J. McConnell
comment: McConnell (hamstring) is practicing in the G League at Noblesville Boom training camp, per Alex Golden of SI.com.

name: Johnny Furphy
comment: Furphy (knee) is practicing with the G League's Noblesville Boom, per Alex Golden of SI.com.

name: Ivica Zubac
comment: Zubac (ankle) is out for Friday's game against the Heat.

name: Ben Sheppard
comment: Head coach Rick Carlise confirmed Sheppard will miss "months" after undergoing surgery to repair a torn meniscus in his left knee, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.

name: Tyrese Haliburton
comment: Haliburton (hamstring) will miss at least the next two weeks of action, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

name: Yanic Konan Niederhauser
comment: Niederhauser (foot) had his third-year team option picked up Thursday by the Clippers, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.

name: Max Strus
comment: Strus (foot) is making progress but is set to miss at least one more week, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.

name: Brandon Ingram
comment: Ingram (Achilles) is making progress but is set to miss at least one more week, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.

name: Bradley Beal
comment: Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.

name: Jordan Miller
comment: Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.

name: Ziaire Williams
comment: Williams has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Warriors due to left foot injury management, Mark Medina of TheSportingTribune.com reports.

name: Adou Thiero
comment: Thiero (knee) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Warriors.

name: Scotty Pippen Jr.
comment: Pippen (back) is listed as questionable for Saturday's game against the Kings.

name: Ty Jerome
comment: Jerome (back) is listed as questionable for Saturday's game against the Kings.

name: Quinten Post
comment: Post (ankle) is doubtful for Friday's game against the Kings.

name: Anthony Edwards
comment: Edwards underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Thursday, the Timberwolves announced.

name: Donte DiVincenzo
comment: DiVincenzo (Achilles) remains confident that he'll return during the 2026-27 season, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.

name: Yves Missi
comment: Missi (knee) won't play in Saturday's game against Atlanta.

name: Jordan Poole
comment: Poole (ankle) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Hawks.

name: Jose Alvarado
comment: Alvarado (ankle) has been ruled out for Friday's game against Philadelphia.

name: Cason Wallace
comment: Wallace underwent surgery Friday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

name: Chet Holmgren
comment: Holmgren underwent a biological treatment Friday to address a small patellar tendon tear and will miss at least 8-10 weeks, Nick Crain of Slam reports.

name: Jalen Williams
comment: Williams (leg) underwent successful surgery Wednesday to "address a fractured left fibula and reconstruction of ankle ligaments following a fracture and dislocation." He will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Tim MacMahon of ESPN.com reports.

name: Alex Caruso
comment: Caruso (ankle) is expected to miss time due to an ankle sprain, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

name: Thomas Sorber
comment: Sorber (knee) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Mavericks.

name: Nikola Topic
comment: Topic (back) will remain on the inactive list for Wednesday's game in Dallas.

name: Jonathan Isaac
comment: Isaac (knee) is out for Friday's game in Toronto.

name: Jalen Suggs
comment: Suggs has been diagnosed with a mild bone bruise in his right knee and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

name: Paolo Banchero
comment: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

name: Noah Penda
comment: Penda was diagnosed with a partially torn right hamstring Saturday, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

name: Izaiyah Nelson
comment: Team president Jeff Weltman said Monday that Nelson (ankle) remains about a month away from returning to the court after offseason surgery, per Philip Rossman-Reich of OrlandoMagicDaily.com.

name: Jaylen Brown
comment: Brown (knee) is out for Friday's game against the Knicks.

name: Jabari Walker
comment: Walker (knee) has been ruled out for Friday's game versus New York.

name: Tacko Fall
comment: Fall (quadriceps) is out for Wednesday's game in Indiana.

name: Dominick Barlow
comment: Barlow will miss at least the next two weeks of action due to a lumbar spine bone stress response, Adam Aaronson of PhillyVoice.com reports.

name: Ariel Hukporti
comment: Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

name: Mark Williams
comment: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

name: Robert Williams III
comment: Williams (knee) is questionable for Saturday's game against the Jazz.

name: Chris Youngblood
comment: Youngblood (ankle) is questionable for Saturday's game against Utah.

name: Ja Morant
comment: Morant has been diagnosed with a Grade 2 left hamstring strain and is expected to miss four weeks, Portland announced Friday.

name: Shaedon Sharpe
comment: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

name: Dylan Cardwell
comment: Cardwell (calf) will be re-evaluated in one week, Brenden Nunes of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.

name: Maxime Raynaud
comment: Raynaud (knee) is progressing in his rehabilitation and will be re-evaluated in approximately two weeks, Brenden Nunes of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.

name: Keegan Murray
comment: Murray (ankle) will be re-evaluated in 10-to-14 days, NBA reporter Marc Stein reports.

name: Ben Simmons
comment: Simmons underwent successful surgery Tuesday to repair a torn right Achilles tendon, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.

name: Tobias Harris
comment: Harris (calf) is listed as out for Saturday's game against Minnesota.

name: Jayden Quaintance
comment: Quaintance has been around the team but has not yet been cleared for basketball activities, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.

name: Kawhi Leonard
comment: Leonard (knee) is expected to be sidelined for at least three to four weeks, Chris Haynes of NBA TV reports.

name: Nate Bittle
comment: Bittle (foot) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Magic, Cody Taylor of USA Today reports.

name: Lauri Markkanen
comment: Markkanen (wrist) is listed as questionable for Saturday's game against Portland.

name: Jaren Jackson Jr.
comment: Jackson has been diagnosed with a torn MCL in his right knee and will be sidelined for 6-to-8 weeks, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

name: Trey Alexander
comment: Alexander won't play Wednesday against the Grizzlies due to a left knee bone bruise.

name: Jusuf Nurkic
comment: Nurkic will miss at least the next four weeks due to a partial plantar plate tear of second toe in right foot, Chris Haynes of NBA TV reports.

name: Justin Champagnie
comment: Champagnie (foot) is expected to miss several months, per Josh Robbins of The Athletic.

name: Tristan Vukcevic
comment: The Wizards announced Thursday that Vukcevic (hip) will be re-evaluated in four weeks.

name: Jamir Watkins
comment: The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.
